title: WorkflowCommandEnvelope
description: Standard JSON envelope returned by every evidara-cli workflow command. Provides structured feedback for agents, operators, and evaluators after each workflow step.

ok.description: Overall command success. false for transport, evaluation, or contract failures.

workflow.description: Stable workflow family name, e.g. source-lifecycle, search-verification.

run_id.description: Durable workflow run identifier. Stable across steps of the same run.

step.description: Stable step identifier within the workflow, e.g. source.inspect, source.apply.

side_effect_level.description: Mutation class of this step. none = read-only; reversible = mutating but compensatable; irreversible = mutating with no guaranteed rollback.

inputs.description: Minimal structured echo of command inputs. Must not include secrets or oversized payloads.

artifacts.description: Key ids, counts, or refs produced by the step. Use domain identifiers where possible.

evidence.description: Supporting facts for operator or evaluator review.

kind.description: Evidence kind: http, contract, object-ref, count, assertion.

status_code.description: HTTP status code for http kind evidence.

value.description: Observed value for count or assertion evidence.

decision.description: Recommended next action and rationale. Guidance for agents and humans; not final authority.

recommended_action.description: Recommended next action, e.g. approve, retry, compensate, needs-human.

confidence.description: Confidence score when produced by a learned module (0.0–1.0).

next_actions.description: Enumerated safe continuations from this step. Enables bounded planner branching.

compensation.description: Recovery metadata when a compensating action is available.

available.description: Whether a compensation action is available for this step.

command.description: CLI command to run in order to compensate, e.g. evidara workflow source compensate --run-id wf_xyz.

note.description: Human-readable description of the compensating action.

error.description: Error message when ok is false.

error_detail.description: Structured error detail for programmatic handling.
